page.notes: The right-hand page is cut off at the scan border; only the first 1–4 letters of its lines are visible, so those lines are fragments marked [?]. The "cipem" at the foot is the catchword. The stray "]" after "Arrianum:" is printed as shown. The reference mark "y" in the margin is printed as a Greek-looking symbol. No other damage noted.
